text:
Natalie M.: hey design — need a set of compact "trajectory" visuals for the Serving Wins webinar + launch socials. Priority: hero diagram (800x420), 3 microtiles (420x420), slide template (16:9) with one data sparkline. Need brand-compliant, high-contrast, and localization-ready. Can we ship drafts by EOD Thu? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jamal D.: timeline noted. Do you have sample data/spark values or placeholder numbers ok?
Natalie M.: placeholders fine, but include callouts for latency vs cost (2 small callouts). Sparkline should show cost dropping, latency stable.
Mikayla (Creative): linking moodboard + palette: https://figma.com/file/serving-wins-moodboard
Mikayla (Creative): palette hex: #0A2F4E (brand blue), #00C2A8 (accent), #F4F6F8 (bg), #1F1F1F (text). Will check contrast.
Jamal D.: tagging accessibility — please run WCAG AA for normal text and AA for large text. If contrast fails, swap accent. Quick check: #0A2F4E on #F4F6F8 = 7.8:1 ✅, #00C2A8 on #F4F6F8 = 2.9:1 ⚠️ (needs alternate treatment)
Lee (Legal): small note — don't use competitor model names or logos. No claims like "cheaper than X". Use neutral language: "lower per-token cost" etc. Also include alt text for all visuals.
Sasha (Ops): we need localized copy slots for EN/FR/DE/JA — keep text layers editable in Figma and provide font fallbacks. Also provide export slices for APAC regions (density 2x).
Jamal D.: asset naming conv (for export): `servingwins_hero_800x420_v1.png`, `servingwins_tile1_420x420_v1.png`, `servingwins_slide_16x9_v1.pdf`
Mikayla (Creative): alt text suggestions (draft): "Chart showing inference cost decreasing over time while latency remains steady, labelled 'Serving Wins'" — will add French + German drafts.
Natalie M.: thanks — please mark draft PR with :eyes: when ready. Mikayla/Jamal — can you ping me directly once first pass is in figma? Prefer iterations in-thread.
Jamal D.: will do. ETA first pass: Thu 11:00 PT. If we hit blockers, we'll move to Fri morning.
design-bot: New export presets created: 800x420 @2x, 420x420 @2x, 1920x1080 for slides. See /design-presets channel.
Mikayla (Creative): uploaded v1 frames to Figma, comments enabled. Link: https://figma.com/file/serving-wins-v1 — added notes about localization layers and suggested copy lengths.
Natalie M.: :thumbsup: love it. Quick ask — include one accessibility variant with higher-contrast accent (use #006E57) so we have a deployable option.
Lee (Legal): approved language placeholders, please send final copy for legal sweep before publish.
Sasha (Ops): once exported, I'll set up inbound routing for the webinar CTA — need final asset filenames and CTA hrefs.
Natalie M.: perfect. thanks team — will consolidate and follow up in the morning. :sparkles:
